content: Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of dantrolene by influencing the metabolism mediated by the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of dapsone through its impact on CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution, monitor closely, or consider alternative therapies. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of daridorexant by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of darifenacin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of darolutamide through mechanisms involving CYP3A4 and P-gp substrates. Avoid coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers. Darunavir increases rifabutin levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism, while rifabutin decreases darunavir levels. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of dasatinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of deflazacort by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inducers. Rifabutin lowers desipramine levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of deuruxolitinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of dexamethasone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of diazepam by increasing its metabolism via CYP3A4. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers may accelerate diazepam elimination, potentially reducing its efficacy. Monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of estradiol valerate/dienogest by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Women should avoid using this contraceptive while on strong CYP3A4 inducers due to reduced contraceptive efficacy. Rifabutin reduces digoxin levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of dihydroergotamine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of diltiazem by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Consider dosage adjustments and monitor pharmacologic effects, such as blood pressure, when rifamycin derivatives are added or discontinued. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of disopyramide by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of docetaxel by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of donepezil by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of doravirine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. If coadministered, increase doravirine dosage to 100 mg twice daily during rifabutin therapy. Rifabutin lowers dosulepin levels by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of doxorubicin by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of doxycycline by increasing its metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown, but monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of dronabinol by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of dronedarone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of dutasteride by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of duvelisib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A inducers, as this may reduce duvelisib efficacy. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of efavirenz by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of elacestrant by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of elagolix by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Elagolix also reduces rifabutin levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of elbasvir/grazoprevir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to reduced therapeutic efficacy. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of eletriptan by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of eliglustat by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A inducers. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of elvitegravir by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of encorafenib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of enoxaparin by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of entrectinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of enzalutamide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. If unavoidable, increase enzalutamide dosage to 240 mg daily during rifabutin therapy. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of eplerenone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of erdafitinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of ergotamine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of erlotinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of erythromycin base by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of escitalopram by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of estradiol by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of ethinylestradiol by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Hormonal contraceptive efficacy may be reduced; use nonhormonal contraceptives instead. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of etoposide by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of etravirine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of everolimus by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of exemestane by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely.
